description: Each picture and video in the ads (with its id) with its own last-30-day results (spend, results, CTR, cost per result), a verdict (good, ok, weak, untested, unused, new) judged among that account's own creatives, whether it is live, whether it matches the current offer, and for videos what was watched: the hook, the offer, voice and on-screen words. Useful for 'which creatives work?', 'which video is best?', 'what should I replace?'.

account.description: An ad account's name, to look at one account; omit for all of them.

id.description: Only this creative: its id, e.g. the one the owner is looking at.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: get_creatives

error.description: Why nothing was done, as a short code.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).

title: Creatives and their results
